question: Under which of the following ministries does 'VAIBHAV' Fellowship Programme announced by the Government of India in June 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is __**4) Ministry of Science & Technology**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The 'VAIBHAV' Fellowship Programme is announced by the Government of India under the **Ministry of Science & Technology**.
 
• The initiative aims to bring together Indian-origin researchers and academicians from across the world to collaborate with their counterparts in India.
 
• The programme is designed to promote and strengthen the global mobility of Indian researchers and foster international collaboration.
 
• It aims to facilitate the exchange of knowledge and expertise in various fields of science and technology.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Ministry of Science & Technology is responsible for the formulation of policies relating to science and technology in India.
 
• It encompasses various departments including the Department of Science and Technology (DST), Department of Biotechnology (DBT), and Department of Scientific and Industrial Research (DSIR).
 
• The 'VAIBHAV' initiative is a part of the government's efforts to enhance scientific research and innovation in the country.
 
• It aligns with the broader vision of making India a global leader in science and technology.
